fanout.description: Maximum number of parallel workers in clush

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for clush

command_timeout.description: Command timeout in seconds for clush; 0 means unlimited

fd_max.description: Maximum number of file descriptors clush may use

history_size.description: Maximum number of commands stored in clush history

maxrc.description: Whether to exit with the maximum exit code of all nodes (yes|no)

node_count.description: Whether to show node count summary (yes|no)

confdir_paths.description: Directories scanned for additional clush.conf files; $CFGDIR expands to the package config dir
